name: Open floor hole
risk: Fall-through hazard near active work area.
action: Cover, barricade, or mark the opening before work continues.

name: Missing guardrail
risk: Unprotected edge exposed to crew traffic.
action: Install guardrail or restrict access until fixed.

name: Loose power cable
risk: Trip and electrical damage hazard across the walkway.
action: Route overhead, tape down, or remove from the path.
